title: Extend, Expand, etc.
credits: Andrew Smith wrote this lesson for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: This week on Ask a Teacher, we answer a question from Ann in China.
sentences.zh: 本周的"问老师"栏目，我们来解答来自中国安安的提问。

sentences.en: Here is part of Ann’s question:
sentences.zh: 以下是安安提问的部分内容：

sentences.en: Hello Teachers, Could you please help me understand the difference between "extend," "expand," "stretch," [and] "enlarge" when I describe an activity that makes something larger than its current state?
sentences.zh: 各位老师好，当我描述一项使某物变得比当前状态更大时，能否帮我理解"extend"、"expand"、"stretch"和"enlarge"之间的区别？

sentences.en: Thank you, Ann.
sentences.zh: 谢谢安安。

sentences.en: We can use the four verbs Ann asked about to express an increase in physical size or amount.
sentences.zh: 我们可以用安安问到的这四个动词来表达物理尺寸或数量的增加。

sentences.en: We can also use them to express increasing the time an activity takes.
sentences.zh: 我们也可以用来表达增加某项活动所花费的时间。

sentences.en: We often use the verb “extend” to talk about increasing the amount of time for an activity or program. For example:
sentences.zh: 我们经常用动词"extend"来谈论增加某项活动或项目的时长。例如：

sentences.en: Officials want to extend the school year by six weeks.
sentences.zh: 官员们希望将学年延长六周。

sentences.en: We can use the verb “extend” to express an increase in people, things, or ideas.
sentences.zh: 我们可以用动词"extend"来表达人、事物或思想的增加。

sentences.en: Consider the following examples:
sentences.zh: 请看以下例子：

sentences.en: The new rule extends to all employees in the company.
sentences.zh: 新规定适用于公司全体员工。

sentences.en: They want to extend the benefits of freedom to people around the world.
sentences.zh: 他们希望将自由的恩惠及于全世界人民。

sentences.en: This research will extend our knowledge.
sentences.zh: 这项研究将拓展我们的知识。

sentences.en: We can also use “extend” to express the distance or the area something reaches. For example:
sentences.zh: 我们也可以使用"extend"来表达某物所达到的距离或范围。例如：

sentences.en: Expand
sentences.zh: 扩大

sentences.en: We use “expand” to express an increase in the size of a project or program.
sentences.zh: 我们用"expand"来表达项目或项目规模的扩大。

sentences.en: And, like “extend,” we can use “expand” to talk about including more people.
sentences.zh: 并且，与"extend"一样，我们可以用"expand"来谈论纳入更多的人。

sentences.en: Consider the following example:
sentences.zh: 请看以下例子：

sentences.en: Officials want to expand the program to include people from developing countries.
sentences.zh: 官员们希望扩大该项目，以纳入来自发展中国家的民众。

sentences.en: We commonly use “expand” in connection with business or industry:
sentences.zh: 我们常将"expand"用于商业或工业领域：

sentences.en: We want to expand our business to reach more customers.
sentences.zh: 我们想把业务扩展出去，接触更多客户。

sentences.en: Stretch
sentences.zh: 伸展

sentences.en: We can use the phrasal verb “stretch out” to express increasing the time to continue an activity:
sentences.zh: 我们可以用动词短语“stretch out”来表达延长某项活动的时间：

sentences.en: I wanted to stretch out my vacation for an extra two or three days.
sentences.zh: 我想把假期多延长两三天。

sentences.en: We can use the verb “stretch” to express improving our ability to do something:
sentences.zh: 我们可以用动词“stretch”来表达提升我们做某事的能力：

sentences.en: Learning a new language will stretch your mind and improve your problem-solving abilities.
sentences.zh: 学习一门新语言会拓展你的思维，提升你解决问题的能力。

sentences.en: Note that when we use the verb “stretch” in this way, we communicate the idea that the improvement might be a little difficult or take a lot of effort.
sentences.zh: 请注意，当我们以这种方式运用动词“stretch”时，传达出的意思是，这种提升可能会有点困难，或需要付出很大努力。

sentences.en: Enlarge
sentences.zh: 扩大

sentences.en: Unlike the verb “extend,” we do not use “enlarge” to talk about an increase in time.
sentences.zh: 与动词“extend”不同，我们不把“enlarge”用来谈论时间的增加。

sentences.en: Instead, it simply means to increase in size or scope.
sentences.zh: 相反，它仅仅指规模或范围的增大。

sentences.en: Scope means all of the things connected to an activity or project.
sentences.zh: “scope”指与某项活动或项目相关的所有事物。

sentences.en: Consider the following example:
sentences.zh: 请看以下例子：

sentences.en: They have enlarged their research team to examine the effects of pollution on animals.
sentences.zh: 他们扩大了研究团队，以考察污染对动物的影响。

sentences.en: For our readers and listeners, what are your questions about American English?
sentences.zh: 对于我们的读者和听众来说，你们关于美式英语有什么问题？

sentences.en: How are you trying to expand your knowledge?
sentences.zh: 你们是如何努力拓展自己的知识的？

sentences.en: We want to hear from you!
sentences.zh: 我们想倾听你们的声音！

sentences.en: Send us an email at learningenglish@voanews.com.
sentences.zh: 请给我们发邮件至 learningenglish@voanews.com。

sentences.en: And please let us know where you are from, too.
sentences.zh: 同时，也请告知我们你来自哪里。

sentences.en: And that’s Ask a Teacher.
sentences.zh: 以上就是“请教老师”节目。

sentences.en: I’m Andrew Smith.
sentences.zh: 我是安德鲁·史密斯。

glossary.def: the good things that result from an action or situation
glossary.zh: 好处; 益处; 利益; 优势
